name: ordinary-env-prefix-is-not-injection
note: GUARD: `FOO=bar mycmd` is an ordinary env-assignment prefix; it is NOT LD_PRELOAD/DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES/DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH, so bash-env-inject-preload does not fire and proc.env.inject:preload is never surfaced. Fails closed to gommage; the point is it does NOT become the injection deny (it would be the same decision kind but the wrong reason).
